record_title: Boundary-charge criterion for subcritical perturbed Brownian reflection
provenance: SCOPE Phase II scientific record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The result is restricted to the subcritical regime nu<1/2. For general singular finite-variation boundaries the contact-charge criterion is exact but implicit; no classification of singular boundaries or quantitative stability rate is claimed. Broader classical Skorokhod/local-time literature remains a residual originality risk; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
